flyer.justification: The flyer is crisp and factual, but the title exceeds the required maximum limit of 6 words.

linkedin.justification: The LinkedIn post strictly adheres to formatting rules, avoids prohibited cliches, and accurately synthesizes key insights from the talk.

summary.justification: Well-structured executive summary that includes all required sections and stays well under the 400-word limit.

instagram.justification: Captures the tone and format of Instagram well with visual cues, emojis, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: Follows all newsletter requirements including a subject line under 50 characters, three distinct subheaded sections, and an engaging conversational tone.

blog.justification: While factually sound and well written, the blog post completely omitted the required comparison/takeaway table and the 'About the Author' section.
